name: Convert anonymous SAM classes to lambda expressions
description: Java SE 8 adds lambda expressions, method references, and enhanced type inference. Anonymous inner classes implementing a single abstract method (SAM) interface can be replaced with lambda expressions, reducing boilerplate and enabling internal iteration idioms.

patterns.reason: Anonymous classes with a single method can be converted to lambda expressions (SAM conversion).

verification_hint: Compile with Java 8 javac; verify anonymous SAM classes were replaced with lambdas and behavior is unchanged.

name: Thread.stop(Throwable) disabled in Java 8
description: Thread.stop(Throwable) has been disabled in Java SE 8 — the method throws UnsupportedOperationException. Code calling Thread.stop() must be reviewed and the deprecated API eliminated.

patterns.reason: Thread.stop(Throwable) is disabled in Java SE 8 and throws UnsupportedOperationException.

verification_hint: Verify no Thread.stop(Throwable) calls remain; JADE's custom .stop() methods are false positives.

name: PermSize/MaxPermSize command-line flags removed
description: Java SE 8 removes the permanent generation. Command-line flags PermSize and MaxPermSize are removed and ignored; if used a warning is emitted for each. Startup scripts must drop these flags.

patterns.reason: Java SE 8 removed the permanent generation; PermSize/MaxPermSize flags are ignored.

verification_hint: Verify no PermSize/MaxPermSize flags remain in scripts or build files.
